title: Quintessentially Nutty Algerian Lamb Tagine
description: A nutty, gooey, and comforting Algerian dish featuring allspice berries and keto-friendly ingredients, with a crispy agemono-deep-fry twist.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the allspice berries, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the almond flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until lightly toasted.
Add the browned lamb back to the pot and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Cover the pot and simmer over low heat for 1.5 hours, until the lamb is tender.
Increase the heat to medium-high and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer, uncovered, for 10 minutes, until the sauce has thickened and the lamb is coated in a gooey, nutty glaze.
